_comment: Solver and energy-grid settings for Famiano (2002) reproduction.
Energy grid:
Famiano used EVENLY SPACED bins of 5 MeV for a 400 MeV 4He jet.
For a 400 MeV jet, 80 bins of 5 MeV covering 0–400 MeV is appropriate.
Set type='linear', e_min=2.5, e_max=402.5, n_bins=80 for this.
Timestep:
gamma = 0.01 per Famiano eq. (4) and text (Section 3).
Initial dt: use estimate_initial_dt() from the initial dY/dt.
Integration method:
Famiano used the IMPLICIT Euler method (eq. 2), not explicit Euler.
The jacobian.py module supports this; run_famiano.py currently uses
EXPLICIT Euler (first-order) which is adequate for the non-thermal
Model B (no thermonuclear reactions). For Model A (hot dense clump),
switch to implicit integration using jacobian.py.
Run time:
Famiano runs until the cloud mass increases by a large factor.
For Model B: mass_rate = 1e-6 Msun/yr on a 1e6 Msun cloud → slow.
The time axis in Famiano's figures is fractional mass change DM/M0.
A sensible t_end for initial testing is 1e6 yr = 3.15e13 s.

time._comment_model_A: Famiano Model A: jet on continuously, run to 1e4 s (Fig. 2 axis, Delta M/M0 ~ 40). The previous on/off schedule is kept above for reference.
time._comment: tmax_s = 1e5 s (~1 day); Famiano (2002) bottom x-axis is in seconds (~10^4 s); dt_s is initial guess only. jet_intervals: list of [on_s, off_s] pairs during which jet injection (and mass loading) is active; the jet can be switched on and off multiple times by adding more pairs, e.g. [[0.0, 1.0e4], [3.0e4, 5.0e4]]. Outside all intervals the cascade (reactions among already-produced non-thermal species + radioactive decay) keeps running until tmax_s. For backward compatibility, a legacy single 'jet_stop_s' value is still honored as [[t0_s, jet_stop_s]] if 'jet_intervals' is absent.

_comment: Famiano: 'energy bin width was taken to be ~5 MeV for a 400 MeV 4He jet'.
Linear grid, 80 bins × 5 MeV = 400 MeV range.
e_min = 2.5 MeV (half-bin below 5), e_max = 402.5 MeV.
Injection bin is bin #79 (0-indexed) at E ~ 397.5–402.5 MeV.

solver._comment: gamma = 0.01 per Famiano eq. (4) Section 3; dt_min/max scaled for seconds-timescale run. dt_rel_floor: species with Y below this are ignored by the timestep controller (default 1e-30 if omitted); 1e-20 stops trace species like 8Li (~1e-25) from throttling dt in the hot Model A cloud.

cascade._comment: 'escape': jet-cloud products lighter than A=6 (n, d, t, 3He) always leave the cloud (original thin-target assumption). 'range': they stop in the cloud wherever their range is shorter than cloud_length_cm (all of them in Model A; low-energy ones even in Model B).

thermonuclear._comment: Off by default: negligible for cold/low-density Model B. Set true for Model A/C (hot/dense clumps), where cloud-species pair reactions matter. Uses core/rate_library.py's build_thermonuclear_library() -- NACRE/CF88/Bao/Table-1-special sources, still missing the Wagoner-sourced special captures (see MISSING_SPECIAL_CAPTURES in that module). Still integrated with EXPLICIT Euler; watch the run log for 'thermonuclear update clipped' warnings, which signal the rates are stiff enough at this cloud's T9/density to need implicit integration instead (see jacobian.py, not yet wired up).
